answer: In an agent economy, every identity carries a clock it cannot cheat: each epoch the ledger publishes a fresh seed, and every agent must solve a Wesolowski delay function over RSA-2048, ten minutes of sequential squaring no GPU farm can parallelize. A 1,000-wallet farm dies by sequential-delay proof at 10,000 CPU-minutes, since each fake burns its own ten minutes and the new seed kills precomputation. The proof is ten kilobytes and verifies in milliseconds, so honest agents pass while fakes queue like a sonnet that cannot be rushed, and the fable of free identities fades to umber dust.
